portal.severityNotConfigured: The severities offered in the portal are not configured, so a ticket cannot be opened there. An administrator chooses them in Settings → Organization.
portal.severityStale: The portal offers {{values}}, which the severity dictionary no longer has ({{allowed}}). An administrator fixes the choice in Settings → Organization.
portal.severityNotOffered: This severity is not offered in the portal. Choose one of: {{allowed}}.

serviceRequest.catalogItemWithoutPriority: The catalog item «{{item}}» has no priority, so a request cannot be opened from it. An administrator sets it in Admin → Service catalog.

comment.ticketClosed: The ticket is closed: its conversation can no longer be changed. Open a new ticket.

list.page: The page number must be a whole number of at least 1 (received {{got}}).

formField.type: "{{fieldType}}" is not a field type. Choose one of: {{allowed}}.
formField.nameTakenInLibrary: A field called "{{name}}" is already in the library.
formField.vocabularyRequired: A {{fieldType}} field needs a vocabulary from the Dictionary: without one it would offer no choices.
formField.vocabularyNotAllowed: A {{fieldType}} field takes no vocabulary: only single and multiple choice pick from the Dictionary.
formField.inUse: The field "{{field}}" is used by the form of: {{forms}}. Remove it from those forms first.
formField.notNumber: The field "{{field}}" is a number, "{{value}}" is not.
formField.notBoolean: The field "{{field}}" is yes/no: use true or false.
formField.notDate: The field "{{field}}" is a date, "{{value}}" is not.
formField.notInVocabulary: "{{value}}" is not a value of "{{field}}". Allowed: {{allowed}}.
formField.oneReference: The field "{{field}}" takes one reference, {{count}} were sent.
formField.fileRequired: The field "{{field}}" needs at least one file.
formField.referenceNotFound: The field "{{field}}" points to something that does not exist here.
formField.notAColumn: A {{fieldType}} field cannot be a list column: only fields stored as a ticket property can.
formField.libraryFull: The field library is full: {{max}} fields is the limit and {{existing}} already exist. Raise the limit on the catalog forms page, or delete a field nobody uses.
formField.notComputable: A {{fieldType}} field cannot be computed: only single-value fields stored as a ticket property can have a formula.
formField.formulaFailed: The formula of field "{{field}}" failed: {{message}}. Fix the formula in the field library.

formTable.noColumns: The table "{{field}}" has no columns: add at least one in the field library.
formTable.duplicateColumn: The table "{{field}}" has the column "{{column}}" twice.
formTable.columnWithoutVocabulary: The column "{{column}}" of "{{field}}" is a choice but has no vocabulary: it would offer nothing.
formTable.columnVocabularyNotAllowed: The column "{{column}}" of "{{field}}" is a {{fieldType}} and takes no vocabulary.
formTable.tooManyRows: The table "{{field}}" takes at most {{max}} rows, {{count}} were sent. Raise the limit on the catalog forms page.
formTable.cellRequired: Row {{row}} of "{{field}}": the column "{{column}}" is required.
formTable.cellNotNumber: Row {{row}} of "{{field}}": "{{value}}" is not a number for "{{column}}".
formTable.cellNotBoolean: Row {{row}} of "{{field}}": "{{column}}" takes yes or no, got "{{value}}".
formTable.cellNotDate: Row {{row}} of "{{field}}": "{{value}}" is not a date for "{{column}}".
formTable.cellNotInVocabulary: Row {{row}} of "{{field}}": "{{value}}" is not a value of "{{column}}" (allowed: {{allowed}}).
formTable.rowRequired: The table "{{field}}" needs at least one row.
formTable.notATable: A {{fieldType}} field takes no table columns: only a table field does.

catalogForm.shape: The form definition has the wrong shape at {{where}}.
catalogForm.sectionId: {{where}}: the section id must use lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
catalogForm.sectionDuplicate: Two sections have the id "{{id}}": ids identify a section, they cannot repeat.
catalogForm.itemField: {{where}}: that is not a field name.
catalogForm.itemWidth: {{where}}: the width must be full or half.
catalogForm.fieldDuplicate: The field "{{field}}" appears twice in this form: a field can be used once.
catalogForm.fieldUnknown: The field "{{field}}" is not in the field library: add it there first, or remove it from the form.
catalogForm.fieldNoVocabulary: The field "{{field}}" is a choice field with no vocabulary: it would offer nothing to choose.
catalogForm.noteRequired: The field "{{field}}" is a note: it carries no answer, so it cannot be required.
catalogForm.conditionMatch: {{where}}: a condition matches either all rules or any rule.
catalogForm.conditionEmpty: {{where}}: a condition needs at least one rule. Remove the condition to always show the field.
catalogForm.conditionField: {{where}}: the rule does not name a field.
catalogForm.conditionFieldMissing: A condition looks at the field "{{field}}", which this form does not contain: the condition could never become true.
catalogForm.answerUnknown: "{{field}}" is not a field of this form.
catalogForm.answerHidden: The field "{{field}}" is not being asked with these answers: it is hidden by a condition, or not offered here.
catalogForm.answerNote: The field "{{field}}" is a note: it carries no answer.
catalogForm.answersWithoutItem: Form answers were sent without a catalog item: a form belongs to a catalog item.
catalogForm.noForm: The catalog item "{{item}}" has no form: there is nothing to answer.
catalogForm.conditionFieldType: A condition looks at the field "{{field}}", which is a {{fieldType}}: only fields stored as a property can be a condition subject.
catalogForm.referenceEndUser: The field "{{field}}" is a reference ({{fieldType}}): it cannot be offered in the portal, because choosing one means searching the CMDB or the staff list. Untick "offer it in the portal".
catalogForm.tooManyFields: This form has {{count}} fields: {{max}} is the limit. Raise the limit on the catalog forms page, or split the request into two catalog items.
catalogForm.limitOutOfRange: A limit must be a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
catalogForm.answerComputed: The field "{{field}}" is computed: its value comes from its formula, it cannot be sent.

scripting.scriptsSwitchedOff: {{what}}: scripts are switched off for this organization. Switch them on in Settings > Organization, or remove the script from the configuration.
